data_a.situation: The Bay 4 hoop trolley was left in front of the TW-441 cradle overnight.
known_facts: The hoop trolley blocked the north walkway at 06:15.
Night shift left a note that the trolley brake had failed.
A spare brake pin is in the red cupboard.
constraints: Keep the note about the trolley factual.
Do not accuse hangar staff of negligence without an investigation.

turns.input_raw:
